Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner wrongly decided to use each film’s infobox “Country” (production country) as a proxy for the director’s country/nationality. This misinterpretation led to comparing USA (film) vs Germany (film) instead of the directors’ actual nationalities. In reality, both directors—Curtis Bernhardt and Carl Boese—are German, so the correct answer should have been “Yes.”
